title: Brown's patents bought by Sharper Image for ion air filters

tellings.quote: He also I believe was responsible for the patents that ended up you know Sharper Image ended up buying them

plain: Michels says he believes the inventor Thomas Townsend Brown was behind patents that the gadget retailer Sharper Image later bought for its ion air filters. He offers this himself, hedged with an "I believe" and without naming a source. If true, it would mean ideas from Brown's unusual electrical research ended up in an ordinary consumer product.
